goal: score-preserving CE runtime speedups only; no ranking/model/blend/candidate changes

current_call_pattern.session_lifetime: once per eval process; reused across all 50 queries
current_call_pattern.tokenization: encode_batch of (query, passage) pairs from scratch every score_pairs call; query re-tokenized per pair
current_call_pattern.tensor_prep: numpy int64 copies of ids/mask/type_ids per batch; no IO binding; no cached encodings
current_call_pattern.E_L10_invocation: Track 1 scores A-pool (~94.1) then new union extras in a second score_pairs; Track 2 L=10 CE latency is estimated from those two timings. Default constructor CrossEncoderReranker() unchanged on the E-L10 path.

measured_bottlenecks.method: isolated microbench: 4 synthetic queries, 104 cs_v1_control passages (ORDER BY chunk_id, not eval labels). Did not score V2-DEVSET-001. Did not open holdout.

split_baseline_fixed_b16_one_query_ms.note: infer dominates; tokenize ~2%; numpy pack negligible. split infer was a busy-machine sample; timed means below are the latency estimates.

measured_bottlenecks.why_unsorted_batch_pad_fails: 26-31% of pairs already occupy 512 tokens. P(a random batch of 16 contains a 512-seq) ~ 1. Unsorted pad=batch therefore still runs width 512. Length-bucketing yields batch widths [33, 85, 164, 309, 512, 512, 512] on the 104-pair set.
measured_bottlenecks.session_reuse: already correct; creating a session per query would add ~300 ms (5%)
measured_bottlenecks.batch_size_1: not the current path (batch 16). batch 1 is slightly faster at pad-512 t4 (~480 ms) and bit-identical; dominated by other wins

SCORE_PRESERVING.scope: synthetic queries + cs_v1_control passages; not V2-DEVSET-001 (CE logits were not stored in EXP-018B artifacts)
checks: unsorted batch-pad vs pad-512 (including short pairs pad-width 143 vs 512)
length-bucketed batch-pad vs pad-512 on 104 pairs

proposed_changes.name: length-bucketed dynamic padding + 8 intra-op threads
proposed_changes.why: attention/linear cost tracks sequence length; unsorted batches are dragged to 512 by long mates; 8 cores were half-idle at intra_op=4

proposed_changes.name: intra_op_num_threads 4 -> 8 (pad-fixed, otherwise unchanged)
proposed_changes.note: subset of #1; use if bucket-pad is declined. Bit-identical on this CPU/ORT.

proposed_changes.name: single union score_pairs instead of A-pool then extras
proposed_changes.flag: call-site only; not a CrossEncoderReranker flag
proposed_changes.note: small alone; required to length-bucket the full L=10 union (104) rather than two groups 94+10

do_nots: no ranking / candidate-set / L / W / parent_n change
do not overwrite SYSTEM-E-WITHIN-DOC.json or D freeze files
do not enable fast=True on the default E-L10 scoring path without a stored-logit gate on V2-DEVSET-001 if those logits are later persisted
